## NURA 04 - Follow-ups
Supabase decides who is due (automation/supabase-followups.sql in the repo). 10:00 EAT: send due follow-ups (text inside 24h window, else template nura_followup). 10:05: owner list to 0703 201 241 (text inside window, else template nura_owner_digest). Failed sends become 'needs_owner' and appear in the owner list. Max 2 follow-ups per promise. See AUTOMATION.md.
